about: Camera-move and look presets for the Moonfactory studio picker. Prompt presets run today on both Wan 2.2 lanes. Fun Camera presets are true camera conditioning and wait on a model download (see each entry's requires). Look vocabulary composes into the same prompt.

composition.motion_prompt_template: {moves}{scene}.{tempo} The look of a film{genre}{era}: {camera_body}; {lens}. Lighting: {lighting}. Color: {palette}.

moves_join.note: From Freefield's Cinema Studio: one move holds best; the model does not always keep the order with two or more.

composition.still_prompt_template: A cinematic film still{genre}{era}: {scene}. The look: {camera_body}; {lens}; {focal}; {aperture}. Lighting: {lighting}. Color: {palette}. High dynamic range, ultra-detailed
composition.still_note: For the future start-image generation feature: Freefield's Cinema Studio draws the first frame with this template, then animates it. Moonfactory has no image model yet (parity gap P0).

tempo.Calm: Calm pacing: slow, unhurried movement in one long take.
tempo.Dynamic: Dynamic pacing: brisk movement and a quick cut to a closer angle halfway through.
tempo.Chaotic: Chaotic pacing: frantic energy, fast action and several rapid cuts between angles.

camera_body.Modular 8K Digital: the crisp, clean detail of 8K digital cinema
camera_body.Full-Frame Cine Digital: the full-frame digital cinema look, natural and smooth
camera_body.Grand Format 70mm Film: the rich detail and fine grain of large-format 70mm film
camera_body.Studio Digital S35: the polished Super 35 digital studio look
camera_body.Classic 16mm Film: the soft, grainy texture of 16mm film
camera_body.Premium Large Format Digital: the smooth, wide-latitude large-format digital look

lens.Compact Anamorphic: subtle anamorphic oval bokeh and horizontal flares
lens.70s Cinema Prime: the warm, slightly soft rendering of 1970s cinema glass
lens.Classic Anamorphic: a classic anamorphic widescreen look with oval bokeh and blue streak flares
lens.Vintage Prime: soft vintage rendering with gentle flare
lens.Halation Diffusion: a halation glow around the highlights

aperture.f/1.4: aperture f/1.4, shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh
aperture.f/4: aperture f/4, balanced depth of field
aperture.f/11: aperture f/11, deep focus clarity, sharp foreground to background

lighting.Silhouette: the subject in silhouette against a bright background
lighting.Practicals: lit only by practical lamps visible in the scene
lighting.Window: soft daylight from a single window at the side
lighting.Overhead: a hard light falling from straight above, deep shadows under the brow
lighting.Backlight: a strong light behind the subject, a glowing rim and flare
lighting.Soft cross: two soft lights crossing from opposite sides
lighting.Low key: low-key lighting, mostly shadow, one small key light
lighting.Neon: colored light from neon signs, magenta and cyan

palette.Teal and orange: teal shadows and warm orange skin tones
palette.Emerald and gold: deep emerald greens with gold highlights
palette.Faded film: faded film colors with lifted blacks
palette.Earth tones: earthy ochre, olive and rust tones

presets.description: The camera circles a near-frozen moment in slow motion. Prompt approximation on Wan 2.2; the true version is a dedicated LoRA route (see inventory).

prompt.fragment: circles around a frozen moment in slow motion, bullet-time style
prompt.compose: The camera {fragment}. prepended to the scene prompt; up to 3 moves joined with ', then ' in picked order (see composition grammar in presets-index.json).

presets.fidelity: approximate: prompt-guided camera work on Wan 2.2, not a baked-in camera control. Freefield's lab note applies here too: one move holds best; with two or more the model does not always keep the order.

presets.name: Static (Fun Camera)
presets.source: Freefield camera-moves app (neuregex/freefield, MIT), workflow adapted to Moonfactory conventions
presets.description: No camera move. The conditioning holds the frame still.

speed.note: Freefield exposes speed as a slider; higher = faster move.

presets.fidelity: true camera conditioning: the Fun Camera model takes the move as an embedding, not prompt text. This is the closest open-weights route to Higgsfield's Camera Controls.
